verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's Router/proxy docs document robust availability- and capability-based switching — automatic fallback to healthy backups, load balancing across deployments, cooldowns/retries, and content-policy-violation fallbacks to different models — which matches 'switch models mid-task by policy.' However, explicit cost-based routing rules (e.g., route-to-cheapest-model policies) are not directly evidenced beyond cost tracking/budgets, and there's no independent hands-on account confirming dynamic mid-task switching in production beyond general praise for 'reliable model switching.' Missing for 10: explicit cost-driven routing policy docs, and independent/hands-on verification of mid-task dynamic switching behavior.
